outlook.statement: Your directors expect to achieve better financial performance in the coming years.

Exxaro's growth strategy is centred on improving capacity utilization, particularly at the Talod facility, while strengthening brand visibility and deepening market penetration across underpenetrated Tier-II and Tier-III markets. The Company continues to expand its channel partner network and build relationships with architects, contractors and institutional buyers to support volume recovery in a competitive pricing environment. On the product front, the Company is investing in design-led innovation and value-added tile categories that can support better realization per square metre. In exports, Exxaro intends to deepen its presence across its current 11-country footprint while selectively evaluating new geographies, building on the structural opportunity arising from the tariff disadvantage faced by Chinese exporters in markets such as the United States. Operational efficiency improvement remains an ongoing priority, with a focus on lifting utilization levels at both plants, optimizing raw material sourcing and managing energy costs, particularly given the sector's sensitivity to natural gas price movements.
